jobs.title: SAP SuccessFactors Project Manager - Czech based
jobs.description:
Job description:

AKT orchestrates the future of work. We bridge the gap between people, complex organizational needs and technology. Our expertise spans the customer journeys from Talent and Skills development to Experience Management and External Workforce solutions. At AKT, we are always becoming - a culture of continuous growth dedicated to helping global brands navigate their transformation journeys with precision and purpose.

SAP SuccessFactors is a cloud-based software for Human Capital Management, supporting topics in Human Resources, such as learning management systems, payroll, talent management, analytics, workforce planning, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Project Management, this is a customer facing role and open to candidates based in Czech Republic.

Project management of SAP SuccessFactors implementation projects and accountable for project success
Stakeholder engagement - manages the relationship with all stakeholders
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of consultants, providing guidance, support, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment
Oversee deliverables quality
Monitors progress and ensure that the project is delivered on time, within scope and within budget and to the customer satisfaction
Manage project risks and mitigation plans
Manages project escalations
Reports on project status on a regular basis to customer and AKT management
Creates and maintains comprehensive project documentation including plans and reports
Work in accordance with the company methodology and policies

Job Requirements:

A Bachelor's degree or higher in relevant field; i.e., industrial engineering, systems information, project management
10+ years of relevant experience in complex information technologies project management, such as ERP or CRM
Experience in project management of HR systems implementation
Committed delivering to customer satisfaction in challenging environments
Professional presentation and communication skills (both written and verbal)
Professional ability in all Microsoft Office applications
High proficiency in both Czech and English - verbal and written
Strong functional understanding of the HR domain
Experience in project management of HR systems implementation - a significant advantage
Experience in HR Process Optimization and Design – a significant advantage
Expertise in SAP SuccessFactors or other HR systems – a significant advantage

Personal Skills:

Quickly adapt to the company culture, norms, and ways of working
Dynamic project leader and team player with strong commitment and drive to accomplish individual and team tasks and goals
Ambitious, driven, self-motivated, flexible and able to meet tight deadlines
Ability to cope with multi-tasking and working independently
Take initiative, exercise sound judgment and result-oriented
Strong analytical and persuasive skills
Customer-oriented and flexible

Flexible working hours  
Stimulating and collaborative working environment
Internal knowledge transfer, training and coaching by our dynamic team of consultants and experts  
International business environment (offices in Cyprus, UK, DACH, India, France, Israel, North America, and Czech Republic)

jobs.title: SAP Project Manager
jobs.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
jobs.description:
SAP Project Manager (Finance)

Contract Period:
January 2027 (12 months)
Location:
Cape Town, Western Cape
Working Arrangement:
Hybrid – 2 to 3 days in the office per week

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager with strong SAP Finance knowledge and a proven track record in managing and delivering complex SAP projects within enterprise environments.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of SAP Finance projects, ensuring that project objectives, timelines, budgets and quality standards are achieved. The individual must have a solid understanding of SAP-specific delivery requirements, including SAP Activate methodology, data migration, system integration, parallel runs, SAP landscapes and architecture.
The role requires a hands-on delivery-focused Project Manager with strong project governance, stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. SAP Project Delivery

Manage the end-to-end delivery of SAP Finance projects, from initiation and planning through to implementation and post-go-live support.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, delivery schedules and resource plans.
Drive project execution in line with agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
Coordinate SAP functional consultants, technical teams, business stakeholders and external implementation partners.
Ensure alignment between SAP Finance requirements, business objectives and technical delivery.

2. SAP Methodology and Implementation

Apply SAP Activate methodology across project delivery phases, including Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realise, Deploy and Run.
Manage SAP implementation activities, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing and deployment.
Understand SAP system landscapes, environments, architecture and transport management.
Coordinate system integration activities and dependencies across SAP and non-SAP platforms.
Oversee cutover planning, go-live readiness and post-implementation stabilisation.

3. Data Migration and Testing

Manage SAP data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation and migration execution.
Coordinate migration cycles and ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Oversee testing activities, including unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and regression testing.
Manage parallel runs, particularly in relation to financial processes, reporting and reconciliation.
Ensure business readiness and successful transition from legacy systems to SAP.

4. Project Governance and Reporting

Establish and maintain appropriate project governance structures, processes and controls.
Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and change requests.
Prepare project status reports, dashboards, steering committee packs and executive updates.
Monitor project budgets, resource utilisation, delivery milestones and performance against agreed targets.
Escalate project risks and delivery challenges proactively and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure compliance with organisational project management standards and methodologies.

5. Stakeholder and Vendor Management

Build and maintain relationships with senior business stakeholders, Finance teams, IT teams and SAP implementation partners.
Facilitate project meetings, workshops, planning sessions and steering committee engagements.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and resolve delivery dependencies.
Communicate complex technical and functional matters clearly to both business and technical audiences.

Minimum Requirements and Experience

Relevant tertiary qualification in Project Management, Information Technology, Business Management or a related field.
Minimum 8–10 years' experience in IT Project Management, with substantial experience managing SAP projects.
Proven experience managing SAP Finance implementations, upgrades, migrations or transformation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Finance processes and functionality.
Practical experience with SAP Activate methodology and SAP implementation lifecycles.
Experience managing SAP data migration, including data cleansing, validation, reconciliation and migration cycles.
Demonstrated understanding of SAP system landscapes, architecture, environments and integration dependencies.
Experience managing parallel runs, particularly for financial systems and processes.
Strong experience in testing management, cutover planning, go-live execution and post-implementation support.
Proven experience in project governance, risk management, financial control and executive reporting.
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, external vendors and SAP implementation partners.

Key Skills and Competencies

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong leadership and project delivery capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and relationship management.
Strong planning, organisational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities and complex project dependencies.
Strong analytical and financial process understanding.
Ability to engage confidently with senior management, Finance executives and technical teams.
Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project risks.
Strong documentation, reporting and presentation skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced SAP Project Manager who combines strong project management and governance expertise with practical knowledge of SAP Finance implementations. They must understand the technical and functional complexities of SAP delivery, particularly around data migration, parallel runs, SAP architecture, testing and cutover management.
The candidate must be comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, Finance teams, technical specialists and implementation partners while maintaining accountability for successful project delivery.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bancontact Company is the leading provider of debit card payment experiences in Belgium, actively promoting a digital payments (r)evolution in the market. With our Bancontact card, Bancontact Pay app, and bank apps integrating our solutions, we serve the large majority of the Belgian community with more than 10 million cards and 6 million mobile app users. Bancontact Company develops new payment experiences for its consumers and merchants that want to pay or get paid online, in-store or with family and friends.

To bring the pace of these evolutions to the next level, we are looking for a Project Manager.

Are you a proud user of our app or want to start participating in our digital evolution? Join our driven and enthusiastic team!

The Project Manager will report to the Chief Operations Officer.

Job location
: Brussels

RESPONSIBILITIES

Certification/Recertification of Bancontact members and certificate holders

You manage the projects related to the onboarding of new partners/activation of new products by existing partners/required periodic recertifications. This can be on Acceptance side (i.e. PSPs, Acquirers and Acquiring Processors) or on Issuing side (i.e. new Issuers/ Issuing Processors).
Some of the tasks that are typically associated with these projects are:
Guiding the partners in their implementation of Bancontact and help them understand the technical aspects of our products and protocols
Managing the certification planning & process, including follow up of the results
Coordinating the set-up of connectivity & communication aspects
Organising the security set-up & security audit together with the Bancontact Security Officer
Supervising card & POS terminal certifications together with the Bancontact Certification Manager
Supporting the Business Development colleagues in their commercial efforts, and specifically in determining the best fit between partners needs and existing solutions
In those cases where a go-to-market track needs to be foreseen, coordinating with the Marketing colleagues to align technical and communication tasks
Communicating internally about status, impediments and successes, and activate internal stakeholders as needed.
For the most complex cases, after the aftercare period perform a handover to the operations team, so that follow up of issues is ensured after project is closed.

Introduction of new products or services

When the introduction of new products requires extensive end-to-end coordination, as project manager you might be tasked to manage the set up ‘in project mode’, from the initial request to the final delivery of the solution. In this role:
You gather the input in terms of requirements and make sure that all the relevant stakeholders are actively involved, so that your project has a clear scope that meets the original goal;
You set up the governance of your project, which you steer as needed to align on progress, but also to regularly communicate both on content and process aspects;
You take charge of the project from initiation until delivery:
You coordinate, organize and monitor the various activities within the project taking into account the priorities and timelines;
You coordinate and activate the internal and external stakeholders to plan respective efforts, but also to mitigate risks, deliver input, find solutions to potential issues;
You ensure the quality of the deliverables in order to provide solutions that meet the needs of the company and of the partner;
You participate actively in the certification and production validation phases and coordinate the participants and activities, as needed.
You have the skills and experience to help with the direct resolution of issues, and you know how and when to activate your stakeholders to obtain the needed support to move further;
Your project does not end with deployment. You are responsible for the aftercare period until a clean move to Business as Usual can be executed;
You will become a knowledge center of the products or services offered by the company and will actively help the Business Development team during presales efforts with partners.

WITH THESE SKILLS AND MINDSET, YOU WILL THRIVE IN OUR TEAM

Master’s degree or equivalent by experience
5+ years of experience in a project manager role in the payment industry

Good knowledge of multiple relevant fields of the card payment industry (card, terminal, ATM, e-commerce, Acquiring, Issuing, mobile payment, …)
Previous relevant experience in coordination of multiple external stakeholders is strong plus
Experience with knowledge management/planning tools
Quick learning curve – your projects may be multi-faceted, from basic timeline management to technically complex implementations. You might not be an expert of everything, but have the interest to learn and ability to absorb information fast
Synthesis skills – you are able to condense details into clear and direct language, you are able to explain key concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Structure – you can easily structure a multitude of information both for yourself and others
Planning – you see the end goal and manage to organize the tasks to meet such goal effectively and on time
Discipline – you are the gatekeeper of your project. You make sure you gather the input you need when you need it, you are proactive and ensure progress in the execution phase
Proactive communication – you communicate openly, activate your stakeholders and are not afraid to discuss any topic. You have excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and are able to connect with people on a personal level
Stress resilience – you keep your cool even in the most difficult moments, always remain professional and are able to handle different projects in parallel
Business feeling – you understand how you project (even the more technical one) is connected to a business goal for the company, and you know how to share this with third parties and to integrate this in your communication
Strong flexibility – every day can be different, and processes will evolve; you are open to adapt to changing needs
Fluency in English is required (written and spoken), as well as fluency in Dutch or French (preferably bilingual NL/FR)

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join a team of professionals with a shared mission: we are dedicated to bringing easy and leading-edge payment experiences to the Belgian community while ensuring the highest level of security and compliance with industry regulations.

Yes, that’s quite a challenge.
But rest assured, you can rely on your colleagues. We are proud of our welcoming, positive, and innovative environment!

We offer you a salary package in line with your competences and experience, and the possibility to grow your skillset based on your ambitions. We support hybrid working via fixed office days per team. Moreover, you’re always welcome to work from our office, where you can enjoy fresh fruit, morning conversations at the coffee machine and of course our company events.

Bancontact Company is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of gender identities, age groups, ethnicities, origins, sexual orientations, parenthood, religious beliefs, disabilities, and backgrounds. If you require adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can support your participation.

Interested in joining us? Then send your CV and cover letter to jobs@bancontact.com

jobs.description:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are

Ready to run
Hungry and driven by urgency
Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Our growth stack has a lot of moving parts. The app and the website send events through a customer data platform to the ad platforms, our mobile measurement partners and the data warehouse. Most launches touch several of those systems and a few different teams.

You'll own the growth roadmap and work day to day with the MarTech and growth engineers who build and maintain all of this. Your job is to keep launches moving, make sure they get properly tested, and make sure the numbers on the other side can be trusted.

What You'll Do

Own the growth roadmap. Turn requests from marketing, paid media and product into scoped tickets with clear owners and dates. Keep the roadmap, runbooks and data flow docs current, and automate the repetitive parts with scripts or AI tools.
Lead testing and QA with the MarTech and growth engineers. Write test plans, check changes in staging and on test devices before they ship, and confirm they worked after launch.
Keep data flowing into paid media. Manage customer data platform destinations, audience syncs, reverse ETL and server-side events. Watch for dropped events, low match rates and schema drift, and write or tweak simple scripts when a setting isn't enough.
Own our relationship with the mobile measurement partners. Debug attribution problems, keep SDK and ad network integrations healthy, and handle support escalations, renewals and roadmap requests.
Keep tracking specs consistent across the app, the website, the customer data platform and web analytics, and dig in when numbers from different sources don't match.
Run SDK upgrades, attribution migrations and new vendor onboarding from evaluation through cutover, with a rollback plan.
Support paid and acquisition work across search, social, app-install networks, app store search ads and affiliates, including click ID plumbing, exclusion lists and test setup.
Bring Privacy and Legal in early, so consent, data-sharing limits and data subject requests are part of the plan and not a surprise at launch.

You Bring

8+ years in technical program management, supporting growth, performance marketing, martech or data teams.
Hands-on time with a customer data platform. You've connected it to several ad platforms, mapped and filtered events, and synced audiences with consent rules applied. You can read a tracking plan or a destination config and spot where a launch will break.
Experience with a mobile measurement partner and a good grasp of attribution: click IDs, ATT and SKAdNetwork, view-through versus click-through, and platform-reported versus first-party conversions. You've debugged discrepancies and dealt with the vendor directly.
Experience doing testing and QA with engineers on tracking or integration launches: test plans, staging checks, debug tools, test devices, and regression checks after SDK or release changes.
You write SQL and pull your own numbers.
A track record of running programs across engineering, design, data and marketing, with clear specs, honest status updates and a written record of decisions.
Good judgment on priorities, and comfort saying no. You're fine with ambiguity and with working asynchronously on a remote-first team.

Nice to Have

Experience at a consumer fintech or another regulated company.
Reverse ETL into paid media (conversion APIs, offline conversions, audience uploads) and keeping it healthy: match rates, deduplication, delays and dropped events.
Reading and writing simple scripts in JavaScript or Liquid, for example to transform an event payload or build a template.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse.
A working understanding of marketing privacy rules: consent, CCPA and similar state laws, GLBA, and limits on sharing customer data with ad platforms. You know when to ask Legal.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1
401(k) plan with company match
Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth
A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

jobs.title: Senior Gas Program Manager- Flexible Location
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175465 

Job Category: Project / Program Management 
Job Level: Individual Contributor
Business Unit: Energy Delivery
Work Type: Hybrid
Job Location: Oakland; Pleasanton

Department Overview

The Gas Strategy Execution department shapes the long-term direction of PG&E’s natural gas system to ensure it remains safe, reliable, affordable, and aligned with California’s decarbonization goals. We translate policy, regulatory, and system needs into actionable strategies and investment plans that guide how the gas system evolves over the next decade and beyond. 

Our team leads PG&E’s True North Strategy for Gas, integrating engineering, planning, operations, regulatory, and policy perspectives to inform system level decisions. We focus on:

•    Developing long range gas system strategies and 10-year plans
•    Identifying cost effective risk reduction and affordability opportunities
•    Advancing methane reduction, RNG, hydrogen, and other decarbonization strategies
•    Supporting load growth and system capacity needs, including large and emerging customers
•    Establishing governance and prioritization frameworks to ensure investments deliver measurable value

Position Summary

The Senior Program Manager develops and maintains the portfolio that supports large load growth on PG&E’s gas distribution system, with a primary focus on data centers and other emerging high-load commercial and industrial customers. The position will also monitor project progress against key milestones, identifies risks and barriers, tracks performance metrics, and facilitates recurring operating reviews to drive accountability, escalate issues, and align cross-functional stakeholders on priorities and actions. The role provides leadership with visibility into customer demand, project status, infrastructure requirements, resource needs, and emerging risks.

The role also develops and implements strategies, processes, governance structures, and infrastructure planning initiatives necessary to address increasing demand associated with data centers and other large commercial and industrial customers. The individual leads cross-functional teams, influences organizational priorities, evaluates infrastructure readiness, develops business cases, and provides strategic recommendations to leadership. 

Location is flexible between Oakland and Pleasanton HQs, please note hiring leader will make final decision of what are appropriate headquarters for the role based on business need. 

Position will require up to approximately 10% of travel time in work schedule. 

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory (Oakland or Pleasanton). 
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job.  The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity.  Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.

A reasonable salary range is:

Bay Area Minimum:$105,000
Bay Area Maximum:$169,000

This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Job Responsibilities
•    Applies advanced knowledge of Program Management to moderate to complex assignments and established programs. Works independently on most issues.  Receives guidance from manager. May participate in the development of new programs.
•    Manage programs, monitor and track work to ensure timeliness, quality and overall program budget.
•    Collaborates with Investment Planning, Integrated Planning, Distribution Integrity Management, Project Services/PMO, Operations, Construction, Division Engineering and others to execute projects in a timely and cost-effective manner.
o    Develop and implement new or improved processes, controls and procedures to improve program compliance, efficiencies and customer satisfaction.
o    Develop, analyze and update current and future work plans and schedules in SAP and other tools to reallocate resources or reprioritize program work.
•    Conducts project plan review meetings and project coordination meetings, issues meeting minutes and ensures resolution of identified issues
•    Monitors execution of work from initiation to closure to ensure units and unit cost is attained.
•    Monitors and manages financial and work management data related to assigned programs in SAP and related tools to ensure accuracy.
•    Develops annual productivity targets. Perform trend analysis, to identify issues with costs or productivity.
•    Conducts benchmarking and best practice reviews for engineering & design.
•    Develops recommendations for improvements to tools and processes and associated training to improve productivity and reduce operation costs. Leads the implementation of best practices and department reliability and affordability team.
•    Develops and implements communication and training for assigned programs to target audience
•    Prepares reports, status updates, variance explanations and budget recommendations. Makes presentations to manager and/or key program stakeholders.
•    Ensures ongoing regulatory compliance with the program.
•    Develops responses to program-related data requests.
•    Assists with GRC testimony research related to the program.

Qualifications-

Minimum Qualifications:  

•    5 years total related experience 
•    SAP experience
•    Project or program management experience

Desired Qualifications:
•    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience
•    Experience in Gas utility maintenance and construction. 
•    5 years engineering experience.
•    PMP Certification
o    Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (Desired)
o    Knowledge of gas utility processes, regulatory requirements, critical success factors, goals and initiatives
o    Good Project management skills
o    Good organizational and process management skills
o    Good collaboration and interpersonal skills
o    Good communication, presentation and influence
o    Analytical problem solving
o    Basic financial, accounting, budgeting knowledge
o    Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Project Planning & Requirements Management

Plan and manage projects across the full delivery lifecycle, establishing clear scope, objectives, milestones, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies and success criteria.
Coordinate requirements, backlog items and acceptance criteria with business and technical stakeholders to support clear delivery expectations and outcome validation.

B. Team & Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate cross-functional business, technical, vendor and delivery teams to ensure responsibilities, priorities, dependencies and decision requirements are clearly understood and actively managed.
Facilitate project meetings, status reviews and stakeholder communications, providing accurate reporting on progress, risks, issues, decisions, financial status and required actions.

C. Delivery Monitoring, Risk & Change Control

Monitor project progress against approved scope, schedule, budget and quality expectations, and take timely action to address variances, blockers or delivery risks.
Track milestone billing against delivery progress and support timely invoicing and payment collection.
Anticipate delivery risks and issues, coordinate mitigation or recovery actions, and escalate material matters promptly to the appropriate stakeholders or governance forum.
Manage scope and change requests by assessing delivery, cost, timeline, resource and dependency impacts before securing the required approval.

D. Project Governance, Documentation & Tools

Maintain project governance records including plans, risk registers, issue logs, decision logs, action trackers and change requests to support accountability and traceability.
Ensure Al projects address data readiness, model acceptance criteria and Al risk and impact assessments in line with the company's Al management system (1S0/IEC 42001) and information security policies.
Use project-management tools (e.g. ClickUp, MS Project) to maintain project information, support reporting and provide transparent visibility of delivery status.

E. Acceptance, Go-Live & Operational Handover

Coordinate UAT, release planning, go-live readiness, acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover to ensure completed deliverables are transitioned effectively.

F. Project Closure & Lessons Learned

Capture project closure outcomes, lessons learned and outstanding actions and ensure relevant project documentation is complete and properly maintained.

G. Other Responsibilities

Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Reporting Officer or Management from time to time.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Project Management or a related field.
A recognized project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent is an added advantage .

Minimum 5 years of relevant project-management or delivery experience in software, digital solutions, Al or a related technology environment.
Experience managing the full project lifecycle, including scope definition, scheduling, budgeting, resource coordination, dependency management and delivery tracking.
Experience coordinating business, technical and vendor teams, managing stakeholder expectations and preparing clear project status reports.
Practical experience maintaining risk, issue, decision and action logs, evaluating change requests and supporting project governance approvals.
Experience coordinating requirements, backlog items, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, go-live and operational handover.
Working proficiency in project-management tools (e.g. ClickUp, MS Project); familiarity with Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery approaches is an added advantage.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Technical Competencies

Project Planning & Resource Management
Agile, Scrum, Kanban & Waterfall Delivery
SDLC & Al/ Software Implementation
Requirements & Backlog Coordination
Risk, Issue, Decision & Change Management
UAT, Release Planning & Operational Handover
Project Management Tools & Reporting

Leadership / Behavioural Competencies

Cross-Functional Leadership
Team Collaboration
Stakeholder Communication
Planning & Organisation
Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
Time Management
Negotiation & Influence
Result Oriented
Attention to Detail
Integrity & Accountability

WHY JOIN US

Comprehensive medical benefits for you, your spouse, and children, ensuring your well-being is our top priority.
Rest easy with our group insurance and term life coverage, providing you with security and assurance.
Stay energized with meal credit that keep you fueled throughout the day.
An in-house futsal court and badminton court for post-work workouts.
A variety of fun-filled events and gatherings to unwind.
Achieve a healthy work-life balance, ensuring you thrive both in and out of the office.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Workplace Violence Prevention
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175784 

Job Category: Project / Program Management 
Job Level: Individual Contributor
Business Unit: Technology & Security
Work Type: Hybrid
Job Location: Oakland

Department Overview  
Corporate Security leads the effort to deliver secure and reliable technology and operational outcomes across the organization. Collaborating closely with Cyber Security, Corporate Security is dedicated to protecting California's critical infrastructure by connecting physical, operational, and cyber defense to reduce risk and enhance resilience. The department consists of forward-thinking security operators, builders, and creators who design and manage protective operations that keep the organization at the forefront of modern security, combining disciplined execution with continuous improvement, innovation, and strong partnerships throughout the business.
  Job Overview  
Corporate Security is seeking a strategic, collaborative program leader to build, operate, and continuously improve PG&E's Workplace Violence Prevention Program across California worksites. This role will translate regulatory requirements into practical, sustainable processes that strengthen prevention, employee awareness, incident response, documentation, and organizational readiness.

The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to Security, Safety, Human Resources, Legal, Facilities, Operations, and employee representatives. The ideal candidate combines strong program management, regulatory discipline, sound judgment, clear communication, and empathy when working through sensitive situations. This role will lead governance, worksite hazard assessments, training, incident-log quality, corrective-action tracking, records management, and executive reporting for the program.

The position is hybrid working from your remote office and in person at various work locations within the service territory for assessments, stakeholder meetings, incident follow-up, and training support. The HQ location will be agreed upon between the successful and hiring manager.

Job Responsibilities  
Lead the Workplace Violence Prevention Program roadmap, annual objectives, governance cadence, performance measures, and executive reporting across covered California worksites.
Own the development, implementation, maintenance, accessibility, and periodic review of the written Workplace Violence Prevention Plan, including required roles, procedures, and worksite-specific content.
Establish meaningful employee and authorized employee representative involvement in hazard identification, control selection, training feedback, incident review, and continuous improvement activities.
Lead and document workplace violence hazard identification, evaluation, and correction activities, including assessments related to operational, staffing, environmental, and incident-driven changes.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
A-AULIE AS

A. Aulie AS er en fremtidsrettet rørentreprenør med røtter tilbake til 1950-tallet.
Vi er i dag 17 ansatte fordelt på prosjekt- og serviceavdeling, og leverer til både privat- og næringsmarkedet – med hovedvekt på profesjonelle kunder.
Vi kombinerer høy faglig kompetanse med struktur, digitalisering og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Målet vårt er tydelig:
Vi skal være det tryggeste valget.

Det betyr at vi skal levere kvalitet i alle ledd – samtidig som vi hele tiden utvikler måten vi jobber på.

Nå søker vi en erfaren prosjektleder VVS
som ønsker et helhetlig ansvar for egne prosjekter – fra anbudskalkulasjon og kontrakt til gjennomføring, økonomi, ferdigstillelse og sluttoppgjør.
Vi ser etter deg som kjenner rør- og VVS-faget godt, har erfaring med prosjektledelse og trives med å ha kontroll på både teknikk, økonomi, fremdrift og mennesker.
Hos oss blir du ikke bare satt til å følge opp prosjekter som allerede er vunnet. Du blir en viktig del av arbeidet med å kalkulere og vinne de riktige prosjektene
, og får mulighet til å følge dem hele veien fra første kalkyle til ferdig levert prosjekt.

Om rollen

Som prosjektleder hos A. Aulie AS får du ansvar for egne prosjekter og blir en sentral del av prosjektavdelingen.
Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:
anbudskalkulasjon og utarbeidelse av tilbud
gjennomgang av konkurransegrunnlag, beskrivelser og tegninger
mengdeuttak og kalkulasjon av timer, materiell og øvrige kostnader
innhenting og vurdering av priser fra leverandører og samarbeidspartnere
vurdering av tekniske løsninger, risiko og forutsetninger i tilbudsfasen
planlegging og gjennomføring av prosjekter
prosjektøkonomi, prognoser og løpende resultatoppfølging
fakturering, endringer, tillegg og sluttoppgjør
fremdrifts- og ressursplanlegging
ledelse og oppfølging av bas og rørleggere
kundedialog og samarbeid med entreprenører, rådgivere og øvrige fag
prosjektering og BIM i samarbeid med interne ressurser
kontraktsoppfølging, kvalitet og HMS
evaluering og etterkalkyle av ferdige prosjekter

Kort sagt får du ansvar for hele løpet – fra kalkyle til sluttoppgjør
.

Kalkulasjon er en viktig del av rollen

Vi ønsker en prosjektleder som allerede har erfaring med anbudskalkulasjon og tilbudsarbeid.
Du må være trygg på å jobbe selvstendig med konkurransegrunnlag, mengdeuttak og kalkulasjon av timer, materiell og øvrige kostnader.
Du må også kunne vurdere risiko, forutsetninger og lønnsomhet før vi leverer tilbud.

Vi bruker Cordel
til anbudskalkulasjon, så erfaring med Cordel er en klar fordel. Har du god erfaring fra andre kalkulasjonssystemer, er det også interessant.
For oss er sammenhengen mellom kalkulasjon og prosjektgjennomføring viktig. Den som kalkulerer prosjektet skal forstå hvordan valg i tilbudsfasen påvirker produksjon, økonomi og sluttresultat.

Vi prosjekterer for flyt

Vi prosjekterer selv i BIM og bruker prosjekteringen aktivt for å gjøre gjennomføringen enklere og mer effektiv.
For oss handler god prosjektering ikke bare om riktige tegninger. Det handler om å sørge for at løsninger, grensesnitt, materiell og nødvendige avklaringer er på plass før arbeidet starter ute på byggeplassen.
Vi kaller det «Prosjektere for flyt»
.
Som prosjektleder får du en viktig rolle i prosjekteringsprosessen og i å sørge for at det som planlegges faktisk gir bedre produksjon ute på prosjektet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant erfaring fra VVS-/rørbransjen og som ønsker å ta et helhetlig ansvar for prosjektene dine.
Du har gjerne:
erfaring som prosjektleder innen VVS/rør
god teknisk forståelse innen sanitær, varme, kjøling og gjerne sprinkler
erfaring med gjennomføring av byggeprosjekter
erfaring med prosjektøkonomi og resultatoppfølging
erfaring med selvstendig anbudskalkulasjon og tilbudsarbeid
forståelse for kontrakter, endringer og tillegg
god digital kompetanse
forståelse for BIM og digital prosjektering

Relevant fagbrev, teknisk fagskole eller ingeniørutdanning er positivt, men vi legger størst vekt på relevant erfaring, faglig forståelse og dokumenterte resultater fra prosjektgjennomføring og kalkulasjon
.

Hvordan er du som person?

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi du:
tar eierskap og ansvar
er strukturert og systematisk
liker å ligge i forkant fremfor å løse problemer når de allerede har oppstått
forstår sammenhengen mellom fag, økonomi og produksjon
er kommersielt bevisst
kan prioritere og ta beslutninger
kommuniserer tydelig med både kunder og medarbeidere
er trygg i samarbeid med entreprenører, rådgivere og øvrige aktører
er løsningsorientert når utfordringer oppstår
evner å sette retning og følge opp menneskene du har ansvar for
ønsker å bidra til å utvikle både arbeidsmetoder, kollegaer og selskapet

Vi ønsker ikke en prosjektleder som bare administrerer prosjektet.
Vi ønsker en prosjektleder som eier prosjektet.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Hos A. Aulie AS får du en sentral rolle i et selskap med ambisjoner om å utvikle både virksomheten og måten vi gjennomfører prosjektene våre på.
Du får blant annet:
ansvar for hele prosjektløpet – fra kalkulasjon til ferdigstillelse
stor påvirkning på egne prosjekter og hvordan de gjennomføres
korte beslutningsveier
mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi jobber og utvikler selskapet videre
egen prosjektering og BIM internt
moderne digitale arbeidsverktøy
en organisasjon som jobber kontinuerlig med struktur og forbedring
dyktige kollegaer og rørleggere
konkurransedyktige betingelser
gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

Vi er opptatt av at de som jobber hos oss skal ha tydelige rammer, gode verktøy og de beste mulige forutsetningene for å lykkes.

Våre verdier

Pålitelig

Vi gjør det vi sier – og leverer når vi skal.
Kvalitetsbevisst

Vi leverer faglig godt håndverk, hver gang.
Lagspiller

Vi hjelper hverandre å lykkes.
Løsningsorientert

Vi finner løsninger – ikke problemer.
Innovativ og fremoverlent

Vi tar i bruk nye løsninger, systemer og teknologi.

Our flagship product, the MiniBox+, brings true plethysmography and full diagnostic PFT into a compact, fully portable system — letting practices run gold-standard lung testing right in their own office, PFT Lab or Hospital.

About the Opportunity

PulmOne is hiring a Salesforce Data Analyst to own the data that runs our US sales organization — turning a large, under-used Salesforce instance into the dashboards, target lists and reports that help sixteen-plus field reps sell more. This is the US sales team's central operations role and works directly with the VP of Sales.

Salesforce today holds thousands of customers and years of sales history, but much of it is incomplete, duplicated or out of date. You will clean it, structure it and make it useful — so that a rep visiting a city sees every target there, not two out of ten. You will also become the US focal point for vendor security assessments, commission calculations and sales agreements.

What You'll Do

Salesforce administration and data integrity

Serve as the US Salesforce administrator, taking over day-to-day administration from our international team
Review the previous day's entries every morning and follow up directly with reps on anything incomplete or unclear — a missing close date, a logged demo that did not happen
Purge and consolidate several hundred duplicate reports into a clean, documented library
Move record ownership from individual reps to territories and positions, so history is never orphaned when people change roles
Maintain the ZIP code territory map and automatic lead routing
Keep opportunity probability, close date and next step accurate across the pipeline

Reporting, dashboards and analysis

Build a personal dashboard for each rep and a team dashboard for sales leadership
Produce the weekly sales scoreboard and pipeline report
Build and run closed-lost analysis — structured loss reasons captured on every lost deal, reported monthly and quarterly
Mine Salesforce for past opportunities, dormant accounts and installed-base expansion, and hand reps prioritized target lists for their territories

Security assessments, agreements and contracting

Become the single US point of contact for hospital and health-system information security assessments (ISAs), business associate agreements and IT agreements, working from a growing library of completed assessments
Prepare GPO and IDN vendor submissions and credentialing packages
Own the agreements process for dealer, finder's fee and rental agreements — drafting from templates, routing for signature and tracking renewals

Systems and integration

Connect Salesforce with the MiniBox Toolkit (MTK) and PulmSuite, including filter usage data
Work with marketing on lead capture, web lead routing and campaign reporting

Rep onboarding and training

Train every new rep on Salesforce during onboarding — typically a half-day session

Publish and maintain the Salesforce hygiene standard and short how-to guides

What you bring

Required

Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, analytics or a related field
Two or more years of hands-on Salesforce experience — reports, dashboards, data cleanup and user administration
Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large, imperfect data sets
Clear, confident communication — you can call a sales rep to fix an entry, and you can train a new rep for half a day
Organized and self-directed, able to own several workstreams without being chased

Preferred

Salesforce Administrator certification
Experience in medical device, healthcare or B2B capital equipment sales operations
Familiarity with hospital vendor credentialing, security questionnaires or GPO contracting
Experience with Salesforce integrations or automation tools

$65,000 - $75,000

If these things describe you, and if you’re great at SQL and have experience analyzing website data, you’re someone we want to talk to.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst with experience analyzing website data. Our data analyst team analyzes everything on our website, not only for their immediate use but also for how they connect to high-level company KPIs. Our Analysts analyze raw data, not only pre-aggregated data, to extract just the right information and diagnose what is happening on our site.
The role requires understanding web development and how data is gathered, analysis of site usage and a/b tests, data visualization, and how different kinds of data can be presented most clearly, and business KPIs and how they are measured.

But more than that, we’re looking for experienced analysts who can bring us new ideas about how to analyze and extract insights from website data. Our ideal candidates have measured KPIs that we haven’t measured or used new ways to explain user retention, or analyzed features of users' data that we haven’t analyzed.

The best thing about our work is that we’re part of an incredibly data-driven company. Everyone from the CEO down uses data every day. The data teams are involved in every single thing the company does.

The Senior Data Analyst will be engaged with the company as a contractor (Private Entrepreneur).

What You'll Do

Analyzing the behavior of users on our siteand apps:

-Build and maintain dashboards that visualize the usage of single or multiple features and how that usage drives comp
any KPIs.
-Answer questions about site usage or user behavior based on deeper analyses.
Analyze and track high-level KPIs such as conversion, retention, churn, recurring revenue, engagement, cross-device usage, e-mail and notification usage, and more.
Communicate with business stakeholders on analysis results, how they relate to business, and what business suggestions result from the analysis.
Run the whole data flow for site and app features, from defining KPIs, specifying data collection for development team implementation, and building and maintaining iterative versions of dashboards with both low-level and high-level views of collected data.
Split tests of product features:

-Design a test with clear success criteria
-Monitor test integrity
-Analyze results and give recommendations
-Use segmentation and clear cohort analysis to validate significant conclusions
-Conduct exploratory analysis to identify trends and opportunities

Prepare executive-ready presentations, decision materials, governance charters, standards, procedures, roadmaps, reports, and performance insights; clearly communicate findings and recommendations to leadership.
Provide strategic leadership with internal stakeholders, organize the work of partner teams to meet program goals, and coach or mentor less experienced coworkers without direct people-management accountability.

10 years of related experience or equivalent.

Master of Business Administration (MBA) or other relevant master’s degree.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Experience designing and operating governance programs in a complex, regulated, or critical-infrastructure environment.
Experience creating, governing, and maintaining enterprise policies, standards, procedures, or other controlled documents.
Management consulting experience, including structured problem solving, executive communication, and facilitation across diverse stakeholder groups.

Bancontact Company is the leading provider of debit card payment experiences in Belgium, actively promoting a digital payments (r)evolution in the market. With our Bancontact card, Bancontact Pay app, and bank apps integrating our solutions, we serve the large majority of the Belgian community with more than 10 million cards and 6 million mobile app users. Bancontact Company develops new payment experiences for its consumers and merchants that want to pay or get paid online, in-store or with family and friends.

To bring the pace of these evolutions to the next level, we are looking for a Project Manager.

Are you a proud user of our app or want to start participating in our digital evolution? Join our driven and enthusiastic team!

The Project Manager will report to the Chief Operations Officer.

Job location
: Brussels

RESPONSIBILITIES

Certification/Recertification of Bancontact members and certificate holders

You manage the projects related to the onboarding of new partners/activation of new products by existing partners/required periodic recertifications. This can be on Acceptance side (i.e. PSPs, Acquirers and Acquiring Processors) or on Issuing side (i.e. new Issuers/ Issuing Processors).
Some of the tasks that are typically associated with these projects are:
Guiding the partners in their implementation of Bancontact and help them understand the technical aspects of our products and protocols
Managing the certification planning & process, including follow up of the results
Coordinating the set-up of connectivity & communication aspects
Organising the security set-up & security audit together with the Bancontact Security Officer
Supervising card & POS terminal certifications together with the Bancontact Certification Manager
Supporting the Business Development colleagues in their commercial efforts, and specifically in determining the best fit between partners needs and existing solutions
In those cases where a go-to-market track needs to be foreseen, coordinating with the Marketing colleagues to align technical and communication tasks
Communicating internally about status, impediments and successes, and activate internal stakeholders as needed.
For the most complex cases, after the aftercare period perform a handover to the operations team, so that follow up of issues is ensured after project is closed.

Introduction of new products or services

When the introduction of new products requires extensive end-to-end coordination, as project manager you might be tasked to manage the set up ‘in project mode’, from the initial request to the final delivery of the solution. In this role:
You gather the input in terms of requirements and make sure that all the relevant stakeholders are actively involved, so that your project has a clear scope that meets the original goal;
You set up the governance of your project, which you steer as needed to align on progress, but also to regularly communicate both on content and process aspects;
You take charge of the project from initiation until delivery:
You coordinate, organize and monitor the various activities within the project taking into account the priorities and timelines;
You coordinate and activate the internal and external stakeholders to plan respective efforts, but also to mitigate risks, deliver input, find solutions to potential issues;
You ensure the quality of the deliverables in order to provide solutions that meet the needs of the company and of the partner;
You participate actively in the certification and production validation phases and coordinate the participants and activities, as needed.
You have the skills and experience to help with the direct resolution of issues, and you know how and when to activate your stakeholders to obtain the needed support to move further;
Your project does not end with deployment. You are responsible for the aftercare period until a clean move to Business as Usual can be executed;
You will become a knowledge center of the products or services offered by the company and will actively help the Business Development team during presales efforts with partners.

WITH THESE SKILLS AND MINDSET, YOU WILL THRIVE IN OUR TEAM

Master’s degree or equivalent by experience
5+ years of experience in a project manager role in the payment industry

Good knowledge of multiple relevant fields of the card payment industry (card, terminal, ATM, e-commerce, Acquiring, Issuing, mobile payment, …)
Previous relevant experience in coordination of multiple external stakeholders is strong plus
Experience with knowledge management/planning tools
Quick learning curve – your projects may be multi-faceted, from basic timeline management to technically complex implementations. You might not be an expert of everything, but have the interest to learn and ability to absorb information fast
Synthesis skills – you are able to condense details into clear and direct language, you are able to explain key concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Structure – you can easily structure a multitude of information both for yourself and others
Planning – you see the end goal and manage to organize the tasks to meet such goal effectively and on time
Discipline – you are the gatekeeper of your project. You make sure you gather the input you need when you need it, you are proactive and ensure progress in the execution phase
Proactive communication – you communicate openly, activate your stakeholders and are not afraid to discuss any topic. You have excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and are able to connect with people on a personal level
Stress resilience – you keep your cool even in the most difficult moments, always remain professional and are able to handle different projects in parallel
Business feeling – you understand how you project (even the more technical one) is connected to a business goal for the company, and you know how to share this with third parties and to integrate this in your communication
Strong flexibility – every day can be different, and processes will evolve; you are open to adapt to changing needs
Fluency in English is required (written and spoken), as well as fluency in Dutch or French (preferably bilingual NL/FR)

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will join a team of professionals with a shared mission: we are dedicated to bringing easy and leading-edge payment experiences to the Belgian community while ensuring the highest level of security and compliance with industry regulations.

Yes, that’s quite a challenge.
But rest assured, you can rely on your colleagues. We are proud of our welcoming, positive, and innovative environment!

We offer you a salary package in line with your competences and experience, and the possibility to grow your skillset based on your ambitions. We support hybrid working via fixed office days per team. Moreover, you’re always welcome to work from our office, where you can enjoy fresh fruit, morning conversations at the coffee machine and of course our company events.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of gender identities, age groups, ethnicities, origins, sexual orientations, parenthood, religious beliefs, disabilities, and backgrounds. About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are

Ready to run
Hungry and driven by urgency
Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Our growth stack has a lot of moving parts. The app and the website send events through a customer data platform to the ad platforms, our mobile measurement partners and the data warehouse. Most launches touch several of those systems and a few different teams.

You'll own the growth roadmap and work day to day with the MarTech and growth engineers who build and maintain all of this. Your job is to keep launches moving, make sure they get properly tested, and make sure the numbers on the other side can be trusted.

What You'll Do

Own the growth roadmap. Turn requests from marketing, paid media and product into scoped tickets with clear owners and dates. Keep the roadmap, runbooks and data flow docs current, and automate the repetitive parts with scripts or AI tools.
Lead testing and QA with the MarTech and growth engineers. Write test plans, check changes in staging and on test devices before they ship, and confirm they worked after launch.
Keep data flowing into paid media. Manage customer data platform destinations, audience syncs, reverse ETL and server-side events. Watch for dropped events, low match rates and schema drift, and write or tweak simple scripts when a setting isn't enough.
Own our relationship with the mobile measurement partners. Debug attribution problems, keep SDK and ad network integrations healthy, and handle support escalations, renewals and roadmap requests.
Keep tracking specs consistent across the app, the website, the customer data platform and web analytics, and dig in when numbers from different sources don't match.
Run SDK upgrades, attribution migrations and new vendor onboarding from evaluation through cutover, with a rollback plan.
Support paid and acquisition work across search, social, app-install networks, app store search ads and affiliates, including click ID plumbing, exclusion lists and test setup.
Bring Privacy and Legal in early, so consent, data-sharing limits and data subject requests are part of the plan and not a surprise at launch.

You Bring

8+ years in technical program management, supporting growth, performance marketing, martech or data teams.
Hands-on time with a customer data platform. You've connected it to several ad platforms, mapped and filtered events, and synced audiences with consent rules applied. You can read a tracking plan or a destination config and spot where a launch will break.
Experience with a mobile measurement partner and a good grasp of attribution: click IDs, ATT and SKAdNetwork, view-through versus click-through, and platform-reported versus first-party conversions. You've debugged discrepancies and dealt with the vendor directly.
Experience doing testing and QA with engineers on tracking or integration launches: test plans, staging checks, debug tools, test devices, and regression checks after SDK or release changes.
You write SQL and pull your own numbers.
A track record of running programs across engineering, design, data and marketing, with clear specs, honest status updates and a written record of decisions.
Good judgment on priorities, and comfort saying no. You're fine with ambiguity and with working asynchronously on a remote-first team.

Nice to Have

Experience at a consumer fintech or another regulated company.
Reverse ETL into paid media (conversion APIs, offline conversions, audience uploads) and keeping it healthy: match rates, deduplication, delays and dropped events.
Reading and writing simple scripts in JavaScript or Liquid, for example to transform an event payload or build a template.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse.
A working understanding of marketing privacy rules: consent, CCPA and similar state laws, GLBA, and limits on sharing customer data with ad platforms. You know when to ask Legal.

Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1
401(k) plan with company match
Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth
A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Department Overview

The Gas Strategy Execution department shapes the long-term direction of PG&E’s natural gas system to ensure it remains safe, reliable, affordable, and aligned with California’s decarbonization goals. We translate policy, regulatory, and system needs into actionable strategies and investment plans that guide how the gas system evolves over the next decade and beyond. 

Our team leads PG&E’s True North Strategy for Gas, integrating engineering, planning, operations, regulatory, and policy perspectives to inform system level decisions. We focus on:

•    Developing long range gas system strategies and 10-year plans
•    Identifying cost effective risk reduction and affordability opportunities
•    Advancing methane reduction, RNG, hydrogen, and other decarbonization strategies
•    Supporting load growth and system capacity needs, including large and emerging customers
•    Establishing governance and prioritization frameworks to ensure investments deliver measurable value

The Senior Program Manager develops and maintains the portfolio that supports large load growth on PG&E’s gas distribution system, with a primary focus on data centers and other emerging high-load commercial and industrial customers. The position will also monitor project progress against key milestones, identifies risks and barriers, tracks performance metrics, and facilitates recurring operating reviews to drive accountability, escalate issues, and align cross-functional stakeholders on priorities and actions. The role provides leadership with visibility into customer demand, project status, infrastructure requirements, resource needs, and emerging risks.

The role also develops and implements strategies, processes, governance structures, and infrastructure planning initiatives necessary to address increasing demand associated with data centers and other large commercial and industrial customers. The individual leads cross-functional teams, influences organizational priorities, evaluates infrastructure readiness, develops business cases, and provides strategic recommendations to leadership.

Position will require up to approximately 10% of travel time in work schedule.

This role will translate regulatory requirements into practical, sustainable processes that strengthen prevention, employee awareness, incident response, documentation, and organizational readiness.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, regulatory discipline, sound judgment, clear communication, and empathy when working through sensitive situations. This role will lead governance, worksite hazard assessments, training, incident-log quality, corrective-action tracking, records management, and executive reporting for the program.

Develop, deploy, and track initial, annual, and as-needed workplace violence prevention training that is role-appropriate, understandable, accessible, and supported by interactive questions and answers with knowledgeable resources.

new_jobs.description:
A-AULIE AS

A. Aulie AS er en fremtidsrettet rørentreprenør med røtter tilbake til 1950-tallet.
Vi er i dag 17 ansatte fordelt på prosjekt- og serviceavdeling, og leverer til både privat- og næringsmarkedet – med hovedvekt på profesjonelle kunder.
Vi kombinerer høy faglig kompetanse med struktur, digitalisering og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Målet vårt er tydelig:
Vi skal være det tryggeste valget.

Det betyr at vi skal levere kvalitet i alle ledd – samtidig som vi hele tiden utvikler måten vi jobber på.

Nå søker vi en erfaren prosjektleder VVS
som ønsker et helhetlig ansvar for egne prosjekter – fra anbudskalkulasjon og kontrakt til gjennomføring, økonomi, ferdigstillelse og sluttoppgjør.
Vi ser etter deg som kjenner rør- og VVS-faget godt, har erfaring med prosjektledelse og trives med å ha kontroll på både teknikk, økonomi, fremdrift og mennesker.
Hos oss blir du ikke bare satt til å følge opp prosjekter som allerede er vunnet. Du blir en viktig del av arbeidet med å kalkulere og vinne de riktige prosjektene
, og får mulighet til å følge dem hele veien fra første kalkyle til ferdig levert prosjekt.

Om rollen

Som prosjektleder hos A. Aulie AS får du ansvar for egne prosjekter og blir en sentral del av prosjektavdelingen.
Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:
anbudskalkulasjon og utarbeidelse av tilbud
gjennomgang av konkurransegrunnlag, beskrivelser og tegninger
mengdeuttak og kalkulasjon av timer, materiell og øvrige kostnader
innhenting og vurdering av priser fra leverandører og samarbeidspartnere
vurdering av tekniske løsninger, risiko og forutsetninger i tilbudsfasen
planlegging og gjennomføring av prosjekter
prosjektøkonomi, prognoser og løpende resultatoppfølging
fakturering, endringer, tillegg og sluttoppgjør
fremdrifts- og ressursplanlegging
ledelse og oppfølging av bas og rørleggere
kundedialog og samarbeid med entreprenører, rådgivere og øvrige fag
prosjektering og BIM i samarbeid med interne ressurser
kontraktsoppfølging, kvalitet og HMS
evaluering og etterkalkyle av ferdige prosjekter

Kort sagt får du ansvar for hele løpet – fra kalkyle til sluttoppgjør
.

Kalkulasjon er en viktig del av rollen

Vi ønsker en prosjektleder som allerede har erfaring med anbudskalkulasjon og tilbudsarbeid.
Du må være trygg på å jobbe selvstendig med konkurransegrunnlag, mengdeuttak og kalkulasjon av timer, materiell og øvrige kostnader.
Du må også kunne vurdere risiko, forutsetninger og lønnsomhet før vi leverer tilbud.

Vi bruker Cordel
til anbudskalkulasjon, så erfaring med Cordel er en klar fordel. Har du god erfaring fra andre kalkulasjonssystemer, er det også interessant.
For oss er sammenhengen mellom kalkulasjon og prosjektgjennomføring viktig. Den som kalkulerer prosjektet skal forstå hvordan valg i tilbudsfasen påvirker produksjon, økonomi og sluttresultat.

Vi prosjekterer for flyt

Vi prosjekterer selv i BIM og bruker prosjekteringen aktivt for å gjøre gjennomføringen enklere og mer effektiv.
For oss handler god prosjektering ikke bare om riktige tegninger. Det handler om å sørge for at løsninger, grensesnitt, materiell og nødvendige avklaringer er på plass før arbeidet starter ute på byggeplassen.
Vi kaller det «Prosjektere for flyt»
.
Som prosjektleder får du en viktig rolle i prosjekteringsprosessen og i å sørge for at det som planlegges faktisk gir bedre produksjon ute på prosjektet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant erfaring fra VVS-/rørbransjen og som ønsker å ta et helhetlig ansvar for prosjektene dine.
Du har gjerne:
erfaring som prosjektleder innen VVS/rør
god teknisk forståelse innen sanitær, varme, kjøling og gjerne sprinkler
erfaring med gjennomføring av byggeprosjekter
erfaring med prosjektøkonomi og resultatoppfølging
erfaring med selvstendig anbudskalkulasjon og tilbudsarbeid
forståelse for kontrakter, endringer og tillegg
god digital kompetanse
forståelse for BIM og digital prosjektering

Relevant fagbrev, teknisk fagskole eller ingeniørutdanning er positivt, men vi legger størst vekt på relevant erfaring, faglig forståelse og dokumenterte resultater fra prosjektgjennomføring og kalkulasjon
.

Hvordan er du som person?

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi du:
tar eierskap og ansvar
er strukturert og systematisk
liker å ligge i forkant fremfor å løse problemer når de allerede har oppstått
forstår sammenhengen mellom fag, økonomi og produksjon
er kommersielt bevisst
kan prioritere og ta beslutninger
kommuniserer tydelig med både kunder og medarbeidere
er trygg i samarbeid med entreprenører, rådgivere og øvrige aktører
er løsningsorientert når utfordringer oppstår
evner å sette retning og følge opp menneskene du har ansvar for
ønsker å bidra til å utvikle både arbeidsmetoder, kollegaer og selskapet

Vi ønsker ikke en prosjektleder som bare administrerer prosjektet.
Vi ønsker en prosjektleder som eier prosjektet.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Hos A. Aulie AS får du en sentral rolle i et selskap med ambisjoner om å utvikle både virksomheten og måten vi gjennomfører prosjektene våre på.
Du får blant annet:
ansvar for hele prosjektløpet – fra kalkulasjon til ferdigstillelse
stor påvirkning på egne prosjekter og hvordan de gjennomføres
korte beslutningsveier
mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi jobber og utvikler selskapet videre
egen prosjektering og BIM internt
moderne digitale arbeidsverktøy
en organisasjon som jobber kontinuerlig med struktur og forbedring
dyktige kollegaer og rørleggere
konkurransedyktige betingelser
gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

Vi er opptatt av at de som jobber hos oss skal ha tydelige rammer, gode verktøy og de beste mulige forutsetningene for å lykkes.

Våre verdier

Pålitelig

Vi gjør det vi sier – og leverer når vi skal.
Kvalitetsbevisst

Vi leverer faglig godt håndverk, hver gang.
Lagspiller

Vi hjelper hverandre å lykkes.
Løsningsorientert

Vi finner løsninger – ikke problemer.
Innovativ og fremoverlent

Vi tar i bruk nye løsninger, systemer og teknologi.

Kan dette være noe for deg?

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis være aktivt på jakt etter ny jobb for å ta kontakt.
Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i rollen og synes dette høres interessant ut, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.
Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uformell prat.

Do you look at websites and think about how they might be personalized? Do you use websites and apps and think about how their features have been designed to be best for a lot of different users? Do you read articles with statistics and think about how they may be misinterpreting the data to get their results? If these things describe you, and if you’re great at SQL and have experience analyzing website data, you’re someone we want to talk to.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst with experience analyzing website data. Our data analyst team analyzes everything on our website, not only for their immediate use but also for how they connect to high-level company KPIs. The role requires understanding web development and how data is gathered, analysis of site usage and a/b tests, data visualization, and how different kinds of data can be presented most clearly, and business KPIs and how they are measured.

But more than that, we’re looking for experienced analysts who can bring us new ideas about how to analyze and extract insights from website data. Our ideal candidates have measured KPIs that we haven’t measured or used new ways to explain user retention, or analyzed features of users' data that we haven’t analyzed.

The best thing about our work is that we’re part of an incredibly data-driven company. Everyone from the CEO down uses data every day. The data teams are involved in every single thing the company does.

any KPIs.

-Use segmentation and clear cohort analysis to validate significant conclusions
-Conduct exploratory analysis to identify trends and opportunities

Demonstrated experience with working in English directly with business stakeholders, understanding their needs, and explaining results
Understanding of website development and operations and how they connect to data gathered.

Experience with report writing and technical requirements analysis, business process modeling/mapping, methodology development, and data modeling

new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175778 

Job Category: Project / Program Management 
Job Level: Manager/Principal
Business Unit: Technology & Security
Work Type: Onsite
Job Location: Oakland

Department Overview  
Corporate Security leads the effort to deliver secure and reliable technology and operational outcomes across the organization. Collaborating closely with Cyber Security, Corporate Security is dedicated to protecting California’s critical infrastructure by connecting physical, operational, and cyber defense to reduce risk and enhance resilience. The department consists of forward-thinking security operators, builders, and creators who design and manage protective operations that keep the organization at the forefront of modern security, combining disciplined execution with continuous improvement, innovation, and strong partnerships throughout the business.
  Position Summary  
Corporate Security is seeking a highly organized, action-oriented Principal Program Manager to build the governance and service-management foundations that enable a modern security organization to perform at its best. This role is ideal for a self-starter who can connect strategy to execution, solve ambiguous problems, and turn complex ideas into practical programs, professional documentation, measurable roadmaps, and sustained operating discipline.

The successful candidate will design and launch the Corporate Security Department’s policy, standards, and procedures governance program; advance the shared-service catalog and maturity roadmaps; and lead the department’s Business Plan Deployment planning process. The role requires the ability to facilitate productive discussions across diverse perspectives, build alignment with functional-area and OCIO partners, create compelling business cases, and present clear recommendations to executives. A passion for corporate security and PG&E’s mission is essential.

The role is hybrid. You will spend your time in the field, your remote office and in-person for meetings and work collaboration 1-3 days a week, on average and throughout the PG&E territory.

Job Responsibilities  
Serve as the recognized subject matter expert for Corporate Security program governance, representing the department in internal, industry, or regulatory forums when appropriate.
Design, build, launch, and own a department-wide governance program for Corporate Security policies, standards, and procedures, including assessment of the current document library, governance design, lifecycle controls, decision rights, and ongoing oversight.
Act as document chief and accountable document owner for assigned Corporate Security standards, partnering with functional-area document experts to develop, revise, approve, publish, maintain, and retire controlled content.
Lead major cross-functional projects and initiatives, translating strategic objectives into executable plans, defined deliverables, milestones, dependencies, governance routines, and measurable outcomes.
Own the ongoing maturity of the Corporate Security shared-service catalog, including catalog completion, service definitions, ownership, maturity roadmaps, key performance indicators, service-level expectations, and performance reviews with functional-area partners.
Develop compelling business cases and funding strategies with service owners, including financial analysis, prioritization, benefits, risks, resource needs, and recommendations for leadership decision-making.
Own the department’s Business Plan Deployment planning process in partnership with OCIO, Corporate Security functional areas, and other business partners, ensuring goals, metrics, initiatives, and accountabilities align to company objectives.
Facilitate cross-functional sessions with diverse stakeholder groups to resolve complex issues, align priorities, anticipate barriers, and develop innovative solutions that support program goals.
Prepare executive-ready presentations, decision materials, governance charters, standards, procedures, roadmaps, reports, and performance insights; clearly communicate findings and recommendations to leadership.
Provide strategic leadership with internal stakeholders, organize the work of partner teams to meet program goals, and coach or mentor less experienced coworkers without direct people-management accountability.

  Qualifications  
Minimum:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
10 years of related experience or equivalent.

  Desired:  
Master of Business Administration (MBA) or other relevant master’s degree.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Experience designing and operating governance programs in a complex, regulated, or critical-infrastructure environment.
Experience creating, governing, and maintaining enterprise policies, standards, procedures, or other controlled documents.
Management consulting experience, including structured problem solving, executive communication, and facilitation across diverse stakeholder groups.
Experience designing, building, or maturing a shared-services model, service catalog, service-level framework, or performance-management program.
Financial management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, business-case development, and funding prioritization.
Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex, cross-functional programs; create compelling business cases; influence senior leaders; and address difficult issues with diplomacy and tact.

Compensation

PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity,  
specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Bay Area Mid: $194,000

This expert role requires a strategic leader with a proven track record in delivering complex projects within defined timelines, budgets, and scope.
